17:29 Local Time, 15:29 GMT, 20:59 IST: A gallant effort from Namibia but they fall short. The openers set them on their way with Jan Frylinck in terrific touch. He was helped by some poor bowling though as he feasted on the short balls. He was helped by Steenkamp who too played his part. The duo put on 119 in just inside 11 overs before the left-hander was dismissed. Gerhard Erasmus came on but couldn't quite replicate his heroics from yesterday with the bat. A blow to the forearm for Steenkamp sent him retired hurt and the equation at the end was too steep for Namibia. An excellent 19th over from Maphaka gave Nqobani Mokoena enough to defend and the job was done. At stages of the chase, it looked like Namibia would pull it off but South Africa held their nerve despite a poor day in the field. Stay tuned for the post-match stuff....
